context: A customer browsing handmade items at the market stall
purpose: Buy a handmade item; teach つくる/売り/最低/わずか/売る/トラブル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: この小物、素敵ね。ぜんぶ手でつくるの？
lines.en: These trinkets are lovely. You make them all by hand?
lines.style: warm browsing mother charmed by the craft

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そうや、ひとつずつ丁寧につくるんや。
lines.en: Yes, I make each one carefully, one by one.
lines.style: gently proud explaining his careful method

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お値段は？ 売り物はどれかしら。
lines.en: How much? Which ones are for sale?
lines.style: polite shopper scanning for the price

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: この棚が売り物やで。最低でも三百円からや。
lines.en: This shelf is for sale. Three hundred yen at the lowest.
lines.style: helpful owner pointing out the priced shelf

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: わずかな差だけど、こっちのほうが好き。
lines.en: It is a tiny difference, but I prefer this one.
lines.style: thoughtful customer weighing a small distinction

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: それ、すぐ売るで、人気やから。
lines.en: That one sells fast, it is popular.
lines.style: nudging Kansai salesman creating gentle urgency

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 包装でトラブルとかない？ 割れ物だけど。
lines.en: Any trouble with the wrapping? It is fragile.
lines.style: cautious mother worried about a breakable item

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 心配ない、丁寧に包むから。
lines.en: No worries, I will wrap it carefully.
lines.style: reassuring craftsman putting the customer at ease

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: pleased shopper deciding to purchase, voice clear and distinctly their own
